title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
**Do you enjoy turning ideas into campaigns that generate real business results?**

**At Smartsign, we're creating our first Growth Marketing Specialist role—a unique opportunity to build our growth marketing capability from the ground up and have a real impact on how we attract new customers.**

**As our first Growth Marketing Specialist, you won't just join a function—you'll help build it.**

### **About the role**


As Growth Marketing Specialist, your job is to help more potential customers discover Smartsign, understand the value we offer and take the next step with us.


You will own the day-to-day execution of our digital marketing activities — from website content and LinkedIn posts to landing pages, campaigns, newsletters and lead conversion. You will help us create awareness, generate inbound demand and convert interest into qualified sales opportunities.


You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Experience and local markets to make sure our marketing activities support measurable business results.


You will play a key role in helping us:

* Reach the right audiences with the right message.
* Increase engagement across our digital channels.
* Improve conversion from interest to opportunity.
* Support Sales with high-quality inbound leads.
* Make better marketing decisions through data and insights.


Sometimes you will also support local market activities in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and Australia — especially when it helps Sales create new opportunities or follow up existing interest.

### **What you will do**

* Create and publish content across our digital channels.
* Plan and execute campaigns that generate awareness and inbound demand.
* Optimize website conversion, customer journeys and lead generation.
* Collaborate with Sales to maximize the value of inbound opportunities.
* Analyze results and continuously improve marketing performance
* Build landing pages, forms and email flows.
* Manage and improve our website and LinkedIn presence.
* Plan webinars, events and targeted campaigns.
* Track traffic, conversions, lead quality and marketing-sourced pipeline.
* Test messages, formats and channels to understand what generates results.
* Support campaigns and sales activities across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and Australia

### **Who we are looking for**


You enjoy creating content, working with digital channels and using data to improve results. You are practical, curious and commercially minded.


You are structured and hands-on. You like to take ownership, get things done and improve marketing step by step. You work well with Sales and use data to see what works and what can be better.

##### **We believe you have:**

* 2–4 years of experience from Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, B2B Marketing or a similar role
* Experience creating and publishing digital content
* Experience with websites, landing pages, campaigns and marketing tools
* Understanding of B2B lead generation, inbound marketing and lead conversion
* A good understanding of how marketing can support traffic, leads, conversion and sales pipeline
* A structured, hands-on and analytical approach
* Strong writing and communication skills in English and Swedish
* Interest in B2B SaaS, digital products and commercial growth
* Curiosity about AI tools and experience using them for research, writing, ideation, content production and campaign improvement


Experience from a SaaS or other B2B software company is an advantage.


It is also a plus if you have worked with tools such as HubSpot, WordPress, Webflow, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Canva, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or similar.  

  

*You don't need experience from every area above but most successful candidates will recognize themselves in several of them.*

### **About Smartsign**


Smartsign is a Swedish SaaS company with customers around the world. Our platform helps organizations communicate through digital screens in offices, stores, healthcare, manufacturing and public environments. Every day, thousands of organizations rely on Smartsign to deliver the right information to the right audience in a simple, secure and scalable way.


We support a wide range of commercial screens, players and customer environments, including both cloud and on-premise needs.

### **Location and practical information**


This is a full-time, permanent position.


The role is based in Stockholm, with a flexible working setup that combines office and remote work. An alternative Smartsign location may also be considered for the right candidate.


You will report to the CEO or appointed marketing lead and work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience and local markets.


Start date by agreement.

### **Interested?**


We'd love to hear from you. We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis.  

For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to julia.karner@smartsign.se.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
#### **The opportunity**


Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.


You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, building and validating solutions that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, this role plays a key part in ensuring reliability, performance, and quality across Polestar’s digital ecosystem.


We are now looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join Polestar Digital at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

#### **Let us describe the challenge we offer**


As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of customer‑facing digital products and internal platforms that support the vehicle purchasing journey.


You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, validating solutions and ensuring that features meet both business and technical requirements before release. Acting as a key partner to Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams, you will translate product requirements into effective test strategies and ensure that defects are identified early and resolved efficiently.


The role combines hands‑on testing, automation, and continuous improvement of quality practices, contributing to scalable and high‑quality systems used globally across markets and internal operations. You will also stay up to date with modern QA methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches.

#### **What you'll do**


You will ensure high‑quality delivery across Polestar’s digital platforms by validating solutions, improving test coverage, and driving continuous improvement in quality practices.


Your responsibilities include:

* Ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled through comprehensive testing of user stories and system workflows
* Designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated tests across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
* Validating quality, reliability, performance, and security of new platform capabilities and releases
* Collaborating with Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, and Designers to translate product requirements into effective test strategies
* Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects, while supporting teams in root‑cause analysis and resolution
* Contributing to test automation frameworks and improving overall test coverage and development practices
* Working closely with cross‑functional agile teams to continuously improve software quality and delivery processes
* Monitoring and evaluating quality metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
* Staying up to date with industry best practices, modern QA methodologies, and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches
* Documenting test plans, test results, and quality standards across the development lifecycle


In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Technical Leads, and Operations teams, ensuring alignment across technical and business needs while driving quality across the full development lifecycle.

#### **Who you are**


You are a structured and analytical quality professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring high‑quality outcomes. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and you focus on identifying and resolving issues early to enable smooth and reliable delivery.


You combine hands‑on testing expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and an interest in modern technologies shaping the future of software quality.


To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

* Strong knowledge and hands‑on experience with Quality Assurance methodologies and software testing principles
* Experience testing modern web applications and distributed systems across frontend and backend technologies
* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
* Understanding of React, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, APIs, and AWS‑based systems from a testing perspective
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and containerized environments
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and experience working in cross‑functional product teams
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem‑solving, and communication skills
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders
* Experience with commerce, payments, financing, order management, or customer journey platforms is considered an advantage
* Atleast 4 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance

#### **People at Polestar**


We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.


Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

#### **Is this you?**


If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.  

  

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.


Send us your resume along with a short note on what makes this role interesting to you. We read everything.


Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

title: AI & Data Engineer
description:
About the Role
 



  





 Our client is building AI capability on top of our payments data platform. The foundation is Looker/LookML, with custom AI agents built on top to generate recommendations from payments data.
 



  





 This is a greenfield role with significant influence over both the technical direction and delivery approach. Rather than implementing a predefined architecture, you will assess the available options, define the target architecture and establish the technical strategy for this new capability.
 



  





 Tech Stack
 



 You'll be working across:
 



  




* Backend: NestJS, Node.js, .NET API, Python (FastAPI)
* Frontend: React, Next.js
* Data platforms: Looker + LookML, BigQuery, MySQL, MongoDB
* Cloud: GCP
* AI: Gemini model APIs, designing and building custom agents on top of the BI layer



  





 What You'll Do
 



  




* Define the technical strategy and architecture for a custom AI agent layer sitting on top of Looker/LookML to produce recommendations from payments data
* Design and build an anomaly detection system for payments and KYC data
* Lead design decisions on how these agents integrate with our existing stack (NestJS/Node, .NET, Python/FastAPI, GCP, BigQuery, MySQL, MongoDB)
* Own the big data pipeline and modelling work needed to support the AI layer
* Set direction where none currently exists, this is a build-it-from-scratch mandate, not execution against a pre-defined spec
* Lead the project end-to-end, from strategy through implementation
* Design the statistical layer that decides whether and how confidently a recommendation should be made — significance/sample-size thresholds, baseline and cohort comparison, anomaly detection, and confidence scoring — before it's handed to an LLM to explain



  





 What You'll Need
 



  




* Proven experience in finance/payments data
* Strong background in big data architecture and large-scale data platforms
* Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered agents or applications
* Experience with BI/analytics tooling, ideally Looker/LookML
* Applied statistics / data science background, anomaly detection, significance testing, time-series baselining, confidence/scoring models.
* Track record of leading a technical project from ambiguous requirements through to a concrete solution and delivery
* Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, given this is a new area for the business

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Avalanche Studios Group is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team!
   

  

 This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and state-of-the-art data processing technologies. You will play a key role in our Data Engineering team, ensuring that our data infrastructure is reliable, performant, and successfully tied to delivering better data systems for our games and publishing activities. This role requires a deep understanding of data engineering methodologies/frameworks in a big-data environment ; coupled to a strong collaborative spirit.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and implement processes to extract, clean, and transform data from various sources to ensure it is ready for modelling/consumption.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers, data scientists/analysts and product stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide them with reliable data solutions ; capturing a complete ecosystem view of in- and out-of-game user behaviors.
* Architect and implement robust, maintainable, and high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines and data systems ; ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and long-term usability.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schemas, and metadata. Ensure that data definitions are consistent and easily accessible to all stakeholders.
* Monitor data pipelines and systems to ensure high availability and performance alongside our analytics engineer ; implement automated data quality checks, validation processes and alerts ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data.
* Write efficient, maintainable, and scalable code using best practices. Conduct code and SQL reviews and provide feedback to ensure high standards of code quality within the team.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, frameworks and best practices in data engineering / analytics / AI and share knowledge with the team.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field ; with 8+ years experience in data engineering or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in big-data technologies and languages, such as Python, Spark, Scala, SQL, and Java.Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Talend, DBT… DBT being a big plus).
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure… GCP being a big plus) ; and experience with “Infrastructure as Code” process (e.g. Terraform).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail ; coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry is a plus!


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

*Desirable*

* Exposure to prefab or modular data centre design and deployment.
* Relevant certifications (NVIDIA, VMware VCP-DCV, BICSI RCDD, or data centre design credentials).


 Ready to make your mark? Apply today and let's build the future together!
   

  

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

title: Financial Systems Engineer
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're looking for an experienced engineer to build and own Lovable's financial systems infrastructure - the systems that power our payment flows, usage metering, monetization, and billing infrastructure.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**Why this role?**
 As we scale globally, our financial systems need to match. We're building a dedicated Financial Engineering team to own everything that connects product usage to revenue — subscription billing, a credit-based usage model, pass-through service billing, and the infrastructure to support new monetization models as we grow.
   

  

 This is a senior role with outsized impact. You won't be stuck maintaining legacy systems. You'll be rebuilding and rearchitecting while we're still small enough to do it right, shaping the architecture that will support our scale-up journey for years to come.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* 8+ years building production financial systems (payments, billing, metering, or fintech infrastructure)
* Deep expertise with payment platforms—subscription billing, international payments, payment lifecycle management
* Strong backend engineering skills with systems handling real money at scale
* Experience with usage-based or consumption billing models
* Track record working in mature environments where you've seen "what good looks like"
* Experience in financial compliance environments—tax, audit standards, or regulated fintech
* Comfortable with ambiguity—you can take a business problem and architect a technical solution


**Technical Skills**
* Understanding of financial data accuracy requirements (reconciliation, audit trails, idempotency)
* Proficiency in backend languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, or similar)
* Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and real-time data processing
* Cloud platform experience (GCP preferred)


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud cost management tools (FinOps)
* Background in revenue recognition (ASC 606) or financial compliance
* Previous work at a company with usage-based pricing
* Experience with workflow engines like Temporal


**What You’ll Do**
 Front-Office Systems
   

  

* Own the billing system of record—from Stripe integration through to the metering ledger
* Build and scale metering infrastructure for our credit-based economy
* Architect billing pipelines for pass-through services with cost attribution and margin tracking
* Design monetization systems that support new pricing models
* Implement fraud detection and payment failure recovery workflows
* Handle multi-currency pricing and settlement for global customers


 Back-Office Systems
   

  

* Build cloud/LLM cost management systems—tracking, allocation, and optimization
* Develop internal tooling for discounts, credits, and promotional mechanics
* Create financial reconciliation pipelines between multiple systems
* Support ASC 606 revenue recognition requirements
* Work with tax engines and compliance tooling


 Cross-Functional
   

  

* Partner with Finance, BizOps, and Product to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Collaborate with Data Engineering on financial data pipelines
* Define technical standards and best practices for financial systems


**What Success Looks Like**
 First 30 Days
   

  

* Ship quick wins—we move fast and learn by doing
* Understand our current payment and billing architecture
* Build relationships with Finance, BizOps, and Product stakeholders


 First 90 Days
   

  

* Own a critical piece of our payment or metering infrastructure
* Ship improvements that directly impact revenue reliability or cost efficiency


 First 180 Days
   

  

* The systems you've built are powering significant revenue
* Financial systems are no longer a bottleneck for product growth


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant
description:

 At NoA Ignite, we design and build digital products that truly make a difference. With more than 400 designers, developers, and strategists across the Nordics and Poland, we combine creativity, technology, and insight to deliver world-class digital experiences for our clients.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant acts as the strategic and technical driving force behind our clients' marketing automation success. Your core focus will be translating customer needs into scalable solutions, managing full-lifecycle implementations, and helping clients maximize their MarTech stack.
 



  





**Who you are & who we are** 




 You are a collaborative problem-solver who genuinely cares about driving client success. You will join our dedicated, 9-person MarTech team in Stockholm, working across a wide variety of industries to deliver innovative solutions for both B2B and B2C customers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 ●
 **Solution Design & Collaboration:** 
 Partner with internal teams and client stakeholders to architect and define effective marketing automation solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
 



 ●
 **End-to-End Project Delivery:** 
 Take ownership of Marketing Cloud implementations and Customer Projects. Manage the entire process from initial requirement gathering and scoping through to configuration, testing, and final deployment.

 Build, manage, and optimize data-driven customer journeys, automated workflows, and highly personalized marketing campaigns to drive client ROI.

 Serve as a subject matter expert for clients. Provide structured training, documentation, and ongoing support to ensure successful adoption and long-term success of their SFMC platform.
 



 ●

 Act as a strategic partner to clients by guiding their long-term marketing automation roadmap. Proactively analyze performance and identify opportunities to leverage advanced SFMC capabilities, optimizing their digital strategy and driving continuous business growth.
 



 ●
 **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Actively monitor SFMC updates, new releases, and industry best practices. Apply these insights to deliver innovative, forward-thinking solutions for our clients. Act as a team player and take active ownership of helping colleagues and sharing solutions and best practices.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● Proven experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Marketing Cloud Next (Growth/ Advanced))
 



 ● Strong understanding of marketing automation, data segmentation, and campaign optimization.
 



 ● University degree or equivalent within a relevant IT field such as computer science or information technology.
 



 ● Excellent communication and project management skills.
 



 ● Salesforce certifications in Marketing Cloud are a plus.
 



 ● Have a good understanding of standard functionality in other Salesforce clouds, primarily Sales/Service Cloud

title: Data Architect
description:
Vi söker dig som vill ta det tekniska ansvaret för hur vi bygger, strukturerar och vidareutvecklar vår dataplattform och sätter de tekniska ramarna och standards som teamet arbetar efter. Vi jobbar i moderna verktyg där AI driver både produktutvecklingen och det dagliga arbetet. Du blir en del av ett tight, erfaret och sammansvetsat team som samarbetar nära.
 



  





**Vad kommer du arbeta med?** 




 Ta ägarskap över den tekniska helheten i vår datainfrastruktur, från hur data flödar in i Google BigQuery till hur den når slutanvändaren via Power BI. Du sätter riktningen, inte bara för din egen kod utan för hur teamet bygger. Konkret innebär det att du...
 


* Äger och driver den övergripande arkitekturen för vår dataplattform och säkerställer att den är skalbar, hållbar och anpassad för framtida behov.
* Definierar riktlinjer, best practices, tekniska standards och ser till att de faktiskt följs.
* Arbetar proaktivt med att identifiera och åtgärda teknisk skuld och risker i datainfrastrukturen.
* Samarbetar tätt med produktutveckling och affärssidan för att säkra att arkitekturella beslut grundas i verkliga behov och levererar värde hela vägen.
* Coachar och stöttar teamet i implementationsfrågor, arkitekturval och teknisk riktning.
* Håller dig i framkant inom datateknik, AI och relaterade plattformar för att kunna sprida rätt kunskap i teamet och organisationen.
* Är beslutsfattare när det finns konkurrerande tekniska perspektiv.



  





**Vad har du gjort tidigare?** 



* Har bred erfarenhet inom Data Engineering i seniora befattningar innehållande arkitekturansvar.
* Har en relevant teknisk utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller liknande — eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Har djup och bred erfarenhet av att designa och ansvara för dataarkitektur i molnmiljö.
* Erfarenhet av Google BigQuery och/eller Microsoft Fabric på arkitekturnivå
* Behärskar SQL och Python på hög nivå och förstår hur tekniska val idag påverkar hållbarheten imorgon.
* Har lett tekniska diskussioner och arkitekturella beslut, inte bara implementerat dem.
* Kommunicerar arkitektur och tekniska vägval tydligt till både utvecklare och beslutsfattare.
* Behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i tal och skrift.



**Meriterande:** 



* Erfarenhet av dbt, Apache Airflow eller liknande orkestrerings- och transformationsramverk.
* Erfarenhet av att integrera mot externa API:er och förstå underliggande datastrukturer.



**Förmågor och personliga egenskaper** 



* Helhetssyn: Du ser bortom den egna koden. Du förstår hur tekniska val påverkar team, produkt och affär, och tar ansvar för konsekvenserna.
* Ledarskap och förändringsledning: Du drivs av att lyfta andra, dela med dig av din kompetens och fatta beslut. Du är en positiv förändringsledare som ser möjligheter i en föränderlig värld.
* Strategisk kommunikation: Du kan omsätta komplex arkitektur till begripliga resonemang, oavsett om du pratar med en utvecklare eller en VD.
* Proaktivitet: Du väntar inte på att problem ska uppstå. Du ser dem komma och förebygger.



  





**Livet på Spiris** 




 Hos oss ska du utvecklas, må bra, göra skillnad och ha kul på vägen. Vi välkomnar dig precis som du är, för vi vet att olikheter gör oss bättre. Vi strävar efter att ligga i framkant – AI och en snabbföränderlig techvärld är en naturlig del av vår vardag. Vi drivs av att utforska ny teknik och söker dig som vill testa nytt och växa med oss. När vi mår bra och utvecklas, kan vi också stötta landets företag maximalt. En sann win-win.
 



 Vår hybrida kultur ger dig flexibilitet i vardagen, samtidigt som våra kontor fungerar som viktiga mötesplatser för gemenskap och inspiration. Vårt hjärta och huvudkontor finns i Växjö och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg och Stockholm. Hos oss blir du en del av ett härligt gäng på omkring 500 kollegor.

title: Data Engineer till Max Matthiessen
description:
**Bygg och utveckla dagens och morgondagens dataplattform med stort tekniskt mandat hos Max Matthiessen i Stockholm.**

Här arbetar du hands-on med datalager, dataflöden och rapportering samtidigt som du är med och formar hur teamet, plattformen och arbetssätten ska utvecklas framåt. Du arbetar nära rådgivare, affären och beslutsfattare där datan faktiskt används varje dag. Om du trivs i miljöer där teamet har stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka hur arbetet bedrivs, då kommer du nog trivas väldigt bra här!
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Det Här Är En Roll För Dig Som Vill Bygga, Inte Bara Förvalta. Hos Oss Får Du
   

  

* En bred och hands-on roll där du arbetar nära både teknik och verksamhet

* Ett seniort och autonomt team med korta beslutsvägar och hög frihetsgrad
* Arbeta nära affären där det du bygger snabbt märks och används i vardagen
* På sikt vara med på en moderniseringsresa där vi successivt rör oss mot Google Cloud och nya arbetssätt
* Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner, både vad gäller ersättning och ledighet


 Vi är dessutom ett team som gillar tempo, samarbete och att lösa problem tillsammans.
   

  

**Det här gör du hos oss**
 Vi arbetar med hela kedjan inom Data & Analytics, från datainhämtning och modellering till rapportering och analys. Rollen är bred och hands-on, med tyngdpunkt mot backend och datalagerutveckling, samtidigt som du behöver förstå hur informationen faktiskt används ute i verksamheten.
   

  

 En stor del av vardagen handlar om att vidareutveckla vårt datalager och hantera dataflöden från både interna system och externa källor, bland annat från försäkringsbolag och affärsnära system. Mycket av vår miljö är byggd i SQL Server med dynamisk SQL, där vi arbetar med ETL-flöden, modellering och datakvalitet nära verksamheten.
   

  

 Vi håller successivt på att lämna äldre rapportlösningar i SSRS till förmån för Power BI, bygger modernare arbetssätt kring versionshantering och CI/CD, och förbereder oss för nästa steg i vår förflyttning mot GCP och BigQuery.
   

  

 För dig innebär det att du både får vidareutveckla det som fungerar bra idag och vara med och forma hur vår framtida dataplattform ska se ut framåt. Du kommer också vara delaktig i tekniska vägval, förbättring av dataflöden och diskussioner kring hur vi kan använda AI och smartare automation för att effektivisera vårt arbete ytterligare.
   

  

**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du blir en del av vårt Data & Analytics-team som idag består av fem kollegor med bred erfarenhet inom data, rapportering och utveckling. Teamet ligger organisatoriskt under Finance men arbetar tvärfunktionellt mot stora delar av verksamheten, från rådgivare och ledning till IT och compliance.
   

  

 Vi arbetar i en miljö där det sker mycket förändring och utveckling. Det innebär att vi prioriterar mycket själva och har stor frihet att påverka hur vi bygger lösningar, arbetar tillsammans och utvecklar våra processer.
   

  

 Vi sitter centralt i Stockholm, Lästmakargatan 22, och arbetar hybrid med tre dagar på plats i veckan.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 Du har arbetat flera år som Data Engineer, BI-utvecklare eller i en liknande roll där du byggt och vidareutvecklat datalager, ETL-flöden och backendnära lösningar i SQL Server. Du är senior nog att ha varit med i miljöer där både teknik, data och verksamhetsbehov förändras över tid, och där du fått kombinera hands-on utveckling med ett större tekniskt perspektiv. Du är van vid att resonera kring systemdesign, teknikval och hur dataflöden och lösningar bör byggas för att hålla över tid.
   

  

 I och med att vi idag arbetar i SSRS, men är på väg mot Power BI, så är erfarenhet av båda värdefullt. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av GCP, BigQuery eller migrering till andra molntjänster är det ett stort plus. Erfarenhet av försäkringsbranschen är ett plus, men inte ett krav.
   

  

 För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du gillar kombinationen av att både lösa konkreta problem och förstå helheten. Du drivs av att förbättra, förenkla och skapa struktur, och har ett naturligt sätt att balansera långsiktighet med leverans här och nu.
   

  

 Du är bekväm med både svenska och engelska som arbetsspråk.
   

  

**Så här får vi kontakt**
 I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig konsult- och rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: IBM Technical Software Solution Architect

title: SAP Business Analytics Lead Consultant
description:
**Är du SAP Business Analytics-konsult med önskan att utvecklas som team lead?**
**Välkommen till oss på NTT DATA - en av världens ledande SAP Partners.**
**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som vill arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan teknik och verksamhet som SAP Analytics Lead hos oss. Utifrån ett intresse för teknik ska du trivas med att arbeta med människor, olika branscher och olika tekniska plattformar. Du har arbetat som senior konsult och utvecklare på SAP-analyslösningar i minimum 7 år och kan bidra i hela processen; från analys av befintliga lösningar, till implementering och efterföljande vidareutveckling av de implementerade lösningarna och önskar arbeta på våra projekt med Datasphere och Business Data Cloud.
   

  

 Erfarenhet och/eller kunskap om rapportering ovanpå SAP ERP är meriterande och du bör ha god erfarenhet av SAP’s rapporteringsportfölj. Du har en passion för att hjälpa dina kunder att få ut det bästa av sina analyslösningar och du kan se helheten i de lösningar som kunden har och vill ha, även om de ofta baseras på stora och komplexa SAP ERP-lösningar.
   

  

 Vår arbetskultur präglas av förtroende, entusiasm och laganda. Vi är övertygade om att en sund arbetslivsbalans är avgörande, och ditt välbefinnande är vår prioritet. Vi kan erbjuda en konkurrenskraftig lön, bonusar och förmåner som kompensation för din kompetens och erfarenhet.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av de flesta av nedanstående punkter:**
* Teknisk analys, arkitektur och konsultverksamhet: minimum 7 års arbetserfarenhet som senior SAP-konsult.
* Meriterande med erfarenhet från försäljningsarbete (pre-sales)
* Trivs med leveransansvar i projekt
* Erfarenhet av SAP:s analysportfölj såsom:
* SAP BW på HANA / SAP BW/4 HANA
* SAP Bex Query Designer / BWMT
* SAP Design Studio / Designer
* SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
* SAP HANA-utveckling (HANA Views)
* SAP CDS-teknik
* Datasphere
* Data warehouse-teknologier, ETL och datamodellering
* Snowflake
* Power BI
* Azure Analytics


**Personliga egenskaper som vi värdesätter, och hoppas att Du har:**
* Social och utåtriktad med intresse att utvecklas som ledare
* God kommunikationsförmåga
* Strukturerad
* Tar initiativ och ansvar med stort engagemang
* Intresse för både teknik och affärsprocesser
* Stor förmåga till självinlärning och inhämtning av ny kunskap
* Lagspelare av rang - som gärna delar med dig av din kompetens


**Vad Vi Erbjuder Dig**
* Möjlighet att arbeta med de största SAP-kunderna/implementeringarna i Sverige och Norden
* Möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken inom SAP Business Analytics, tillsammans med de andra bästa analyslösningarna som Azure Analytics och Snowflake
* Det största, mest kompetenta och snabbast växande SAP Business Analytics-teamet i Norden, som också har gedigen expertis utöver SAP Business Analytics
* En flexibel arbetsdag med fokus på en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid
* En informell organisation, med platt struktur och lagom högt i tak
* Fokus på professionell utveckling, kompetensutveckling och goda möjligheter till internationella karriärmöjligheter
* Sociala aktiviteter, kickoff events mm.
* En organisation med konkurrenskraftiga villkor


**Om NTT DATA Business Solutions och Analytics**
 NTT DATA Business Solutions är ett internationellt framåtblickande IT-företag och en av världens ledande SAP Partners. Vi levererar allt från rådgivning till implementering av SAP-lösningar inklusive efterföljande drift och support. NTT DATA Business Solutions har mer än 15 000 högkvalificerade SAP-anställda i nästan 30 länder, fördelade på 5 regioner. I Norden har vi idag 500+ anställda.
   

  

 Vi ser ett starkt växande behov på marknaden, där våra kunder efterfrågar råd och assistans inför sin digitala transformationsresa, till exempel inom Data Platform, Molnlösningar och Big Data. Vårt huvudfokus har traditionellt sett varit kopplat till SAP och deras Business Analytics-portfölj, men de senaste åren har vi även fokuserat starkt på andra rapporteringsplattformar, som Azure Analytics/PowerBI och Snowflake. En av NTT DATA Business Solutions största styrkor är kombinationen av djupgående SAP- och Analytics-expertis. title: Unreal Engine Technical Director (Gameplay)
description:
*Do you want to work at the intersection of Unreal Engine, AI, real-time animation and cutting-edge streaming technology? At Avanti Studios, you will be part of building next-generation live casino experiences that blur the line between reality and gameplay. By combining motion capture, advanced gameplay systems and photorealistic real-time rendering, the team is pushing the boundaries of what interactive entertainment can look and feel like.* 




  





**About the role** 




 As an Technical Director at Avanti Studios, you will architect and implement core gameplay systems for a new generation of interactive live casino experiences. You will work in a highly technical environment where gameplay programming, multiplayer functionality, motion capture and real-time rendering come together to create photorealistic digital human experiences. You will collaborate closely with animators and technical disciplines in a team with strong focus on innovation, performance and R&D. As Technical Director, you’ll remain hands-on in development while playing a key role in building and shaping the technical department.
 



  





 The role is based in Stockholm and the team primarily works from the office.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 You will play a central role in developing Avanti’s platform and gameplay systems. Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Design and implement gameplay systems for live casino games using Unreal Engine
* Integrate WebRTC streaming technology with gameplay mechanics
* Work with Metahuman characters and live capture data integration
* Develop player interaction systems that combine responsive gameplay with real-time character behaviour that works seamlessly with live dealer streams
* Create robust, scalable multiplayer game logic and networking solutions
* Optimize performance for web-based streaming environments with real-time Metahuman rendering
* Collaborate closely with animators and artists to integrate motion capture data into Metahuman characters
* Implement UI/UX systems for player interaction and game controls
* Contribute to gameplay architecture, technical tooling and long-term platform development



  





**Your profile** 




 We believe you have several years of hands-on experience working in Unreal Engine within gaming or other technically advanced real-time environments. You likely have experience developing gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality and/or interactive experiences where responsiveness and performance are critical.
 



  





 To succeed in the role, we also see that you have:
 


* Strong experience with Unreal Engine, preferably UE5.5 or UE5.6 as well as strong proficiency in C++
* Experience with Blueprint visual scripting
* Solid understanding of gameplay programming patterns and architecture
* Knowledge of networking and multiplayer game development
* Familiarity with WebRTC or streaming technologies (preferred)
* Experience optimizing for performance and memory constraints
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Portfolio demonstrating gameplay development work

 Experience with Human Behaviour AI, real-time streaming or video integration, as well as familiarity with Metahuman and live capture systems, is considered meritorious. Experience optimizing Metahuman performance for streaming environments is also highly relevant for the role. In addition, experience from the gaming or gambling industry, including understanding of casino game mechanics and player behaviour, is seen as a strong advantage.
 



  





**About Avanti Studios** 




 Avanti Studios is an innovative technology company at the forefront of next-generation live casino solutions within the iGaming industry. By combining Unreal Engine, motion capture, AI-generated characters, 3D animation, and cloud-based real-time streaming, the company creates scalable and immersive gaming experiences for leading operators such as LeoVegas and Svenska Spel. title: Trust & Safety Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** Millions of people build on Lovable every month. A small fraction try to abuse it. You'll build the adaptive systems that stop monetary fraud, platform abuse, and bot attacks before they reach our users.

**Why Lovable?**
----------------


Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.


We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years building anti-fraud, anti-abuse, or risk systems at consumer scale (payments, marketplaces, fintech, or large social platforms).
* Strong backend engineering - Go, Python, or TypeScript - and comfort working close to the data.
* Experience with disrupting sophisticated fraud campaigns and attacks, knowledge of rules engines, real-time feature stores, ML scoring, device fingerprinting, and behavioral signals.
* You think in adversaries: you can model an attacker, ship a counter, and measure it before they adapt.
* Pragmatic about precision/recall trade-offs. You protect users without punishing them.
* Bonus: experience with LLM-specific abuse (prompt injection at scale, generated-content fraud, credit farming) or with chargeback and payments fraud at a Stripe/Adyen/Braintree-scale merchant.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and ship the fraud platform that protects Lovable's payments, credits, and free tier from abuse.
* Build real-time detection: signals, features, scoring, and decisioning that act in milliseconds.
* Run a tight feedback loop with chargebacks, support, and trust & safety to label, learn, and re-deploy weekly.
* Stand up bot defenses across signup, app generation, and publishing - without breaking legitimate users.
* Own the metrics that matter: fraud loss rate, false-positive rate, attacker time-to-defeat.

**About your application**

* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.
   

  

 Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.
   

  

 With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
   

  

 If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
* Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
* Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
* Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
* Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
* Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
* A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.


**Bonus points if you have**
* Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
* Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Frontendutvecklare till PTS
description:
Vill du utveckla moderna och tillgängliga webblösningar som gör skillnad för samhället? Nu söker vi en frontendutvecklare för ett vikariat på 80 procent under perioden 1 oktober 2026 till 31 januari 2027, då en av våra uppskattade kollegor går på föräldraledighet. Här får du arbeta i ett engagerat utvecklingsteam där teknik, samarbete och användarupplevelse står i fokus.
   

  

**Vi jobbar med det alla tar för givet. Att kunna kommunicera. Hos oss får du se till att det fungerar nu och i framtiden. För alla.**
 Avdelningen för verksamhetsutveckling ansvarar för drift, förvaltning, system-, verksamhets- och processutveckling. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar både egenutvecklade lösningar och standardsystem och ansvarar för PTS:s it-system, webbplatser och e-tjänster. Här arbetar utvecklare, förvaltare, projektledare, kravanalytiker och andra specialister tillsammans i tvärfunktionella team.
   

  

*Jag som blir din chef heter Paula Fagerlund. Jag tror på tillit före kontroll och på att bra lösningar skapas tillsammans. Som chef är jag tydlig med riktning och förväntningar, men ger stort utrymme för eget ansvar, nya idéer och olika perspektiv. Jag uppskattar när människor vågar tänka innovativt, ifrågasätta invanda arbetssätt och hitta smartare sätt att lösa uppdraget. För mig är ledarskap något vi gör i vardagen, genom dialog, samarbete och gemensamt ansvar för helheten.*
**Om rollen**
 Som frontendutvecklare blir du en del av ett mindre utvecklingsteam med 3–5 personer där ni tillsammans utvecklar och vidareutvecklar moderna webblösningar med React. Du är delaktig genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från analys och lösningsdesign till implementation och vidareutveckling.
   

  

 Du arbetar med att integrera frontend mot interna och externa API:er och bidrar även med utveckling i C#, kodgranskning, test och gemensamma kodbaser. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med både utvecklarkollegor och verksamheten genom möten och workshops. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att utveckla tillgängliga digitala tjänster enligt WCAG.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som trivs med att lösa komplexa problem där alla svar inte alltid är givna. Eftersom teamet är litet behöver du vara flexibel, ta ansvar och uppskatta ett nära samarbete där ni tillsammans utvecklar både teknik och arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om teamet**
 Enheten ansvarar för IT-tjänsteutveckling och arbetar med både utveckling och förvaltning av PTS digitala lösningar. Här arbetar utvecklare, förvaltare, projektledare och kravanalytiker tillsammans i mindre team med bred kompetens och stort engagemang. Kulturen präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och ett prestigelöst arbetssätt där vi hjälps åt för att skapa lösningar med hög kvalitet.
   

  

**Om dig**
 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du samarbetsorienterad och uppskattar att arbeta nära andra för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Du är kreativ och tycker om att lösa problem på nya sätt samtidigt som du är självgående och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du kommunicerar tydligt och bidrar till ett gott samarbete både inom teamet och med verksamheten. För oss är dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga, därför kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid dessa.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Avslutad eftergymnasial utbildning om minst 2 år inom programmering, exempelvis från universitet, högskola eller yrkeshögskola (YH).
* Aktuell flerårig och dokumenterad erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med praktisk erfarenhet av React, HTML5, CSS och versionshantering i Git samt förståelse för CI/CD flöden.
* Aktuell erfarenhet av att bygga e-tjänster
* Aktuell praktisk erfarenhet av Highcharts
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.


**Det är även meriterande om du har:**
* Praktisk erfarenhet av UX.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Storybook.
* Erfarenhet av arbete på PTS eller annan beredskapsmyndighet.


**Vårt erbjudande**
 Vi tar livet på allvar. Hos oss kan du ha ett liv på och utanför jobbet. Mår du bra, mår vi bra. Därför erbjuder vi konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till distansarbete. Vi har även generöst friskvårdsbidrag och två friskvårdstimmar varje vecka.
   

  

 Dessutom får du förmånliga villkor för lunch, semester, föräldraledighet, pension och vid sjukdom. Här kommer du arbeta i moderna aktivitetsbaserade lokaler på Hälsingegatan 38. Som statlig myndighet erbjuder vi en trygg och stabil arbetsmiljö där du kan känna dig säker.
   

  

 Vi skapar morgondagens samhälle och måste ligga i framkant. Hos oss kommer du att växa med uppgifter hela tiden.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 80 procent under perioden 1 oktober 2026 till 31 januari 2027. Placering i Stockholm. Din tjänstetitel blir systemutvecklare.
   

  

 För att vi ska kunna göra en rättvis och objektiv bedömning av din kompetens ber vi dig att inte inkludera bild, personnummer eller adress i ditt CV. Vi har valt att inte efterfråga personligt brev då vi istället använder urvalsfrågor. Detta för att vi vill lägga fokus på din erfarenhet och kompetens, vilket bidrar till en mer effektiv och rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Tester kommer att ingå i processen. Om du har skyddade uppgifter, vänligen kontakta vår HR-specialist.
   

  

 För ytterligare information, vänligen kontakta enhetschef Paula Fagerlund, paula.fagerlund@pts.se eller HR-specialist Denise Brosché, denise.brosche@pts.se För frågor relaterade till våra lokala fackliga arbetstagarorganisationer, vänligen maila till saco@pts.se eller st@pts.se.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As an
 **Analytics Engineer** 
 in the Analytics Foundation team, you help the whole company use data with confidence. You sit in a small team with real ownership: we shape how analytics engineering is done here, not only what gets built. You will make architectural decisions for data modelling and set the bar for quality, maintainability, and how we work. This is not a role where you only implement models from a backlog of “orders”; you partner with the business and with technical teams, surface trade-offs when needed, and help prioritise work that compounds.
   

  

 We spend most of our time on larger initiatives that improve the platform and how people use data, rather than reacting to a constant stream of ad-hoc questions. The team has a high degree of autonomy over its agenda, little firefighting, and we have invested for years in automating repetitive work so we can focus on impact. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling and with AI-assisted workflows, including coding agents and agent-style automation where they genuinely speed up design, review, and deliver, while staying responsible for correctness, governance, and clarity for stakeholders.
   

  

 You will develop and maintain core models, quality practices, and governance; support the warehouse and pipelines; and help teams get the most from BI and GTM tooling. Tools in our stack include Snowflake, dbt core, Hex, Prefect, Fivetran, and Hightouch (among others).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, own, and evolve core data models and the modelling architecture; including how they connect to pipelines, freshness, and operational reliability in the warehouse.
* Empower the organization to use and interpret data.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders from problem framing to shipped artefacts: clarify requirements, suggest better approaches when a request would not scale, and drive or co-drive cross-team initiatives that improve how data is used.
* Collaborate closely with other data professionals; this includes giving actionable feedback in code reviews as well as actively supporting with data modeling
* Combine subject matter expertise and a high level business understanding to contribute to the direction and strategy for Mentimeter in the realm of data modeling, AI-Analysis, BI-tooling and data activation in GTM-Tooling.
* Develop, own and maintain data modeling standards and the data development experience
* Improve how we work at scale: thoughtful automation and AI-assisted engineering (e.g. coding agents and repeatable workflows) with human accountability for correctness and compliance.
* Maintain and grow how knowledge is surfaced, e.g in semantic models, a data catalog, or documentation


**We Believe You Have**
* Roughly 4-7 years of relevant hands-on experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst, or similar (or equivalent depth if your path is non-linear).
* Strong SQL and sound judgment in data modelling (grain, reusability, naming, and how metrics should behave).
* Experience partnering across departments, including leading or co-leading cross-functional work that shipped something others use.
* Strong business acumen with an understanding of sales, marketing, and product analytics.
* Ability to map ambiguous stakeholder needs to clear, maintainable models and artefacts.
* Experience with BI-tools and development of BI features
* Knowledge of software collaboration using git.
* Communication in English with both technical and non-technical audiences; interest in helping others grow their data skills.
* Experience working with GDPR-sensitive data and collaborating with legal experts on compliance assessments.


**It Is Beneficial If You Have**
* Hands-on experience with dbt (or similar)
* Experience with a semantic or metrics layer
* Experience using AI-assisted coding or coding agents in a disciplined way (reviews, tests, documentation), with clear judgment about automation vs verification for production data work.
* Professional experience working in an agile environment


**Not Required**
* Swedish is not required (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities).
* A cover letter is not required as part of your application


**📍 Location** 
**:**
 This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.
   

  

 Please note that we do
 *not* 
 offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.
   

  

**💡Our Recruitment Process**
* Introduction interview
* Competence interview, including a live case.
* Culture interview
* References & Offer


**Compensation**
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is SEK 50,000–SEK 68,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
   

  

 Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
   

  

 We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.
